args.instructions: Write a Python class named LegacyModel that: 1) loads /work/out/frame.csv, /work/out/scores.csv, and /work/out/coef.csv; 2) stores the coefficients from coef.csv; 3) implements a predict method that computes the score for each row using the same linear combination of input features as in the original R script (matching column names exactly); 4) returns the predicted probability and decision matching the exported scores.csv; ensure all numeric operations use proper dtype conversion.
